stem.text: A source X emits a sound wave of constant frequency $f$.
The wave is subsequently received at a stationary detector Y.
The frequency of the wave that is detected by Y is less than $f$.
What could be the reason for this?

A.text: Between X and Y, the wave undergoes diffraction.

B.text: Between X and Y, the wave undergoes reflection.

C.text: X is moving away from Y.
